description: The SDM Smart Radar draws a spider web over n axes where each axis carries its own scale — a score out of 50 and a score out of 10 sit side by side on the same web without one crushing the other. Key features: Independent per-axis scales: every axis is scaled from its own observed min and max, with an optional shared mode when the axes really do share a unit Manual axis bounds: a gear-icon editor pins the minimum and maximum of any axis — plot a rating against 0..10, not against whatever the current filter produces Small multiples: one radar per field value, per legend value or per measure, on shared axes, up to 5 × 3 radars with a centred partial last row Reference ghost: the reference series repeated as a grey dashed thread in every radar of the grid, so each profile is read against it Significance testing: up to three independent tests, each comparing every series to a reference series axis by axis, or to an external reference such as last year or a benchmark Four display modes for the results: icon (custom base64 arrows), marker, label background or text Threads: straight or smooth closed curves, adjustable width and style, optional markers and area fill with transparency Graduations: ticks on the spokes, a web joining equal graduations, or concentric circles, with optional graduation values on every axis Background image: a base64 image under the web — a target, a…
